📖 About this site

January 10, 2026

⚙️ Built with 11ty · Hosted on GitHub Pages · Analytics by GoatCounter · Source on GitHub

I wanted a minimal place to:

  • Share my projects — a lot of them are unfinished, but that is part of the process
  • Write about what I am learning — graphics, rendering, game dev and everything in between
  • Keep a devlog — to document progress and look back on later

No frameworks, no build tools beyond 11ty, no cookies. Just plain HTML, CSS and a bit of JavaScript.
